it gave the accusation to the Chronicler; in the verse Abijah speaks it

actions.new_text: In these four verses the Hebrew verb of saying is rendered 'think': the Assyrian asks whether words are strategy, Abijah accuses Jeroboam and Israel of thinking to withstand the Lord, and the Spirit says so the house of Israel thinks. It is the inner or said claim of those addressed. Verses: 2Ki 18:20, 2Ch 13:8, Isa 36:5, Eze 11:5.
actions.reason: evidence validation (B5): it gave the accusation to the Chronicler; in the verse Abijah speaks it

actions.new_text: In these three verses 'think' is reckoning or counting: whether one holds a thing just, whether one would reckon the deep to be white-haired, and the Lord taking account of the son of man. Verses: Job 35:2, Job 41:32, Psa 144:3.
